turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
At this time, we are unable to accommodate any changes, returns, exchanges, or cancellations once an order has been finalized. This includes any requests to cancel your order.

For more information, please check out our Refund Policy.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
At Evry Jewels, all sales are final. This means we are unable to accommodate any changes, such as adding items, to an order once it has been placed. 🙂

If you would like to purchase additional items, we recommend placing a new order on our website.

To make these changes, you will need to enter your email address to confirm your identity.
